definitions: A device, typically made of metal or plastic, used for fastening things together or holding them in place.
A short extract from a film or television programme.
The pace or speed at which something moves or is done.
A magazine or similar container for holding cartridges in a firearm.
examples: She fastened her hair with a clip.
He gave the hedge a quick clip.
We watched a clip from the new movie.
They were moving at a fair clip.
He loaded a fresh clip into the rifle.
